Sunday Ride

Ottawa, Canada · Road

Sunday Ride is a road group ride in Ottawa, Canada. It rolls every Sunday at 9:00 am local time from Changes weekly (Oct 4, 2026: Millennium Park 'n' Ride, Orleans).

For visitors

Club rides are members-only for insurance. To try one, buy a one-time $10 Club Day Pass from Ontario Cycling (credited back if you join) and contact the club's Group Riding Director at rides@ottawabicycleclub.ca first. Register for a ride on obcrides.ca before the cut-off (Oct 4 closes Oct 3, 5:00 pm). Route and start are emailed the evening before.

First time on this ride? Here’s the drill
Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before the meet time. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: pace groups by speed and distance, set by who shows up with a ride leader; the fastest groups are performance-focused. It's no-drop: if you fall off the back, someone waits. That's the point of a group ride.
Check
Look at their Facebook page the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Sunday Ride group ride

The Ottawa Bicycle Club's Sunday road ride. Riders sign up on the club's ride calendar and split into groups of 6 to 12 by speed and distance, each with a ride leader. Starts move around the city each week. The club's rule is no-drop unless a ride says otherwise.
